notes.title: Mighty Knight Legacy celebrates Game Devs of Color Expo!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We are proud to be selected as part of Game Devs of Color Expo this year! 
Be sure to wishlist Mighty Knight Legacy if it sparks joy! 
Also, don't forget to checkout other cool games created by awesome devs of color!

- FIREBEAST TEAM -

notes.title: Mighty Knight Legacy combat demo is coming to Steam & itch.io on March 21st!
notes.content:
Fellow warriors! We are releasing a combat demo, it will be available on Steam and itch.io! Yes, you read that right! The demo is not only for PAX East visitors but everyone! Mark your calendar on March 21st, tell your friends/family and prepare to slash some wicked monsters! En garde!  

So you are coming to PAX East? That is even better! We are obviously happy to meet you, in-person!
Pay us a visit at Booth 14110, whack some monsters and let us know what you think! See you in Boston!

notes.title: Mighty Knight Legacy is coming to PAX East 2024!
notes.content:
Fellow warriors! We are excited to tell you that Mighty Knight Legacy will be at PAX East. 
Are you new to Mighty Knight? or perhaps you already knew it since the era of flash games? We are obviously happy to meet you, in-person! Pay us a visit at Booth 14110 & get your hands on Mighty Knight Legacy demo! 

See you at Boston!

notes.title: Thank you Taipei Game Show! See you next year!
notes.content:
Thank you for all visitors who get their hands on Mighty Knight Legacy at Taipei Game Show, we hope you enjoyed the game and the swags! For those who have not got the chance, you are next!

notes.title: Mighty Knight Legacy is coming to Taipei Game Show 2024!
notes.content:
Surprise! Mighty Knight Legacy is coming to @TaipeiGameShow 2024! Pay a visit to Softsource booth (M102) at the B2C Zone, it's your chance to try out the very first demo and don't forget to snatch some swags! See you at #TaipeiGameShow2024 #indiegame #game #rpg #actionrpg #steam

notes.title: Mighty Knight Returns!
notes.content:
Dear fellow warriors!

Our heroes might have long gone but their legacy lives!

We are excited to announce [b]Mighty Knight Legacy[/b] is coming in 2024!

[previewyoutube=EEZUQZK9s14;full][/previewyoutube]

Grab your [strike]weapon[/strike] controller and fight your way through hordes of ferocious monsters in the land of Medania.

Play together along with your friends or solo with the help of our reliable AI.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676990/Mighty_Knight_Legacy/]Let's march together![/url]
[/b]
